newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish parliament backs full NATO integration.
newsitem.headline: Spanish parliament backs full NATO integration.

text.p: The Spanish parliament on THursday approved the country's full integration into NATO's military command.

Under former Socialist prime minister Felipe Gonzalez, Spain joined NATO in 1982 but froze integration into the military wing pending a referendum on continued membership. The 1986 referendum passed with 52 percent of voters saying "yes".
Parliament voted 293-23 in favour of integration with four abstentions. The government's resolution was backed by Gonzalez, now the main opposition leader.
Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar told a parliamentary debate on Wednesday a more active role in NATO would secure Spain's place among the leading nations of Europe.
